## Website Information

**Live Website URL:** https://pure-alone.github.io/vertex-site  
**GitHub Repository URL:** https://github.com/pure-alone/vertex-site  
**Project Type:** Group Website (Business)

## Reflection

We built and deployed a group business website to GitHub Pages using R Markdown. Through the process we learned how `rmarkdown::render_site()` generates a multi-page site, how to configure `_site.yml` to output to the `docs/` folder for GitHub Pages, and how to automate builds using GitHub Actions. The key technical challenge was configuring the Actions workflow to render the site and push the generated `docs/` files back to the main branch; we solved it by using a simple action script that installs R, renders the site and commits `docs/`. Collaboration required frequent commits and branching to avoid conflicts; we used feature branches and code review via pull requests.

## Website Overview

A small company site containing a home page, an about/services page, a team page, and two case studies demonstrating web & analytics work. The site includes contact pointers and links to the GitHub repository.
